## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and signed the [CLA](../CLA.md) (the bot will ask on the first pull request)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `pytest`, `ruff check`, `ruff format --check` and `mypy` pass
- [ ] User-visible strings are in the locale files (at least Russian and English)
- [ ] Schema changes come with an Alembic migration that works on SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL
- [ ] No secrets, real tokens, server addresses or customer data in code, tests, docs or screenshots
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or settings changed
